text:
```yaml
name: Claude Code

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]

jobs:
  claude:
    if: contains(github.event.comment.body, '@claude') && (github.event.comment.author_association == 'OWNER' || github.event.comment.author_association == 'COLLABORATOR')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Claude Code
        uses: anthropic/claude-code@v1
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
```
